visualCharacteristics: Tabbed testimonials: one large panel at a time (portrait image + name + role + quote), with a row of avatar tabs below/beside it. Each avatar tab shows a small round portrait, name, and role, and switches the active testimonial.
contentPattern: One row per testimonial. Each row has a portrait image cell and a text cell (name + role + quote).
usage: Use to showcase multiple testimonials or quotes that the reader can switch between via an avatar menu.
